[SWS_ComM_00899]
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_09083
⌈On entering state COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION the ComM channel state machine
shall go to sub-state COMM_FULL_COM_NETWORK_REQUESTED, if not a specific sub-
state is specified in the transition.⌋
Rationale for [SWS_ComM_00899]: When switching from COMM_SILENT_COMMUNI-
CATION, the ComM channel state machine can switch directly to sub-state COMM_
FULL_COM_READY_SLEEP, if specified in the transition, see [SWS_ComM_00296].
